name: Minor Manifestation of Water
summary: The Minor Manifestation of Water is an elemental spirit found along North Tide's Run on the coast of Silverpine Forest. It serves as a vital trial for Horde shamans seeking to commune with and master the element of water. Before this peaceful spirit can be consulted, initiates must first cleanse its corrupted counterpart.

sections.title: A Spirit of the Western Tides
sections.body: Lurking along the mist-shrouded shores of North Tide's Run, west of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, the Minor Manifestation of Water represents an essential rite of passage for developing shamans. Water elementals embody life, renewal, and fluidity, but they can easily fall victim to malevolent blight. An initiate must face and defeat a corrupted manifestation of this elemental before the pure Minor Manifestation of Water can reveal itself. Once cleansed, the spirit offers guidance to shamans completing their sacred journey to fashion a Water Totem.

faq.q: Where can I find the Minor Manifestation of Water?
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Water appears along North Tide's Run, on the western coast of Silverpine Forest just west of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Why is the elemental hostile when I first approach?
faq.answer: A shaman must first summon and destroy the Corrupt Minor Manifestation of Water. Only after defeating the corrupted presence does the peaceful manifestation appear to speak with you.
This spirit is a crucial contact in the shaman quest chain 'Call of Water,' through which shamans ultimately earn the ability to cast their Water Totem.

faq.q: Can non-shamans interact with this spirit?
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Water exists specifically to guide shamans completing their spiritual trials. Other adventurers will find little reason to interact with it.

angles.text: Cleansing the corruption from this elemental and receiving its blessing is the final milestone in attuning to the tides and forging your Water Totem.
Troll, orc, and tauren shamans travel all the way from Kalimdor to the shores of Lordaeron to commune with this spirit.
